Content.SourceString: 店里的豆子库存不太够了，结果对门蔬菜店今天也缺货，真倒霉！
Content.LocalizedString: We're running low on beans at the shop, and to make matters worse, the vegetable store across the street is out of stock today too. Talk about bad luck!

Content.SourceString: 我从其他店订了一些，你今天打算来店里的话，顺路帮我捎过来吧。拜托拜托，给你免单！
Content.LocalizedString: I ordered some from other shops. If you're planning to stop by today, could you pick them up on your way? Pretty please! I'll give you a free order in return!

Content.SourceString: 我正好打算去店里。
Content.LocalizedString: I was planning to stop by the shop anyway.

Content.SourceString: 不过，免单的话……我能打包带走吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Free order, huh? Can I take it to go?

Content.SourceString: 喂喂，别说这么吓人的话嘛！
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, hey, don't say such scary things!

Content.SourceString: 好吧，血亏我也认了，都可以免！
Content.LocalizedString: Fine, I'll take the loss! You can have it to go!

Content.SourceString: ……不过，点太多了我也做不过来哈，适量，适量，哈哈。
Content.LocalizedString: …Hey, don't go overboard with the order, or I'll be swamped, haha! Keep it reasonable, alright?

Content.SourceString: ……不过，点太多了我也做不过来哈，适量，适量，哈哈。
Content.LocalizedString: …Hey, don't go overboard with the order, or I'll be swamped, haha! Keep it reasonable, alright?

Content.SourceString: 看情况吧……有空的话，我会去帮你取的。
Content.LocalizedString: Let me see… I'll pick them up for you if I have time.

Content.SourceString: 没事没事，看你什么时候方便吧！
Content.LocalizedString: No worries, just come whenever it's convenient for you!

Content.SourceString: 没事没事，看你什么时候方便吧！
Content.LocalizedString: No worries, just come whenever it's convenient for you!

Content.SourceString: 上次真是谢谢你啦！要不是你，我还真不知道该怎么解决那个订单。
Content.LocalizedString: Thanks a bunch for your help last time! I'd have been completely lost with that order if it weren't for you.

Content.SourceString: 这两天我试制了新口味的炸豆腐，有空的话要不要来店里尝一下？
Content.LocalizedString: I've been experimenting with a new Fried Tofu flavor these past couple of days. Wanna drop by the shop sometime and give it a taste?

Content.SourceString: 那我就恭敬不如从命了。
Content.LocalizedString: I'd be honored to accept your invitation.

Content.SourceString: 店主这是打算拿我试毒吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is the shop owner trying to use me as a poison tester?

Content.SourceString: 这叫什么话，我难道会害你吗？还不是想到你之前帮了我的忙！
Content.LocalizedString: Come on, you think I'd ever do anything to harm you? I just wanted to thank you for helping me out before!

Content.SourceString: 顶多就是有一点点点点点点辣罢了。
Content.LocalizedString: It's just a tiiiiiny bit spicy, that's all.

Content.SourceString: 快点来啊，一定不会让你失望的！
Content.LocalizedString: Come on over! I promise you won't be disappointed!

Content.SourceString: 快点来啊，一定不会让你失望的！
Content.LocalizedString: Come on over! I promise you won't be disappointed!

Content.SourceString: 之前让你试吃过的新品，我又改良了一下，你什么时候有空了再来店li
Content.LocalizedString: I made some improvements to that new item you taste-tested before. Drop by whenever you're free!

Content.SourceString: （速太 已下线）
Content.LocalizedString: (Sota is offline)

Content.SourceString: 店主？
Content.LocalizedString: Are you alright?

Content.SourceString: 怎么回事？
Content.LocalizedString: What's going on?

Content.SourceString: 还记得之前来店里找事的那帮小鬼吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Remember those punks who came looking for trouble at my shop before?

Content.SourceString: 现在想想，带头的那个跟当年的我还怪像的。
Content.LocalizedString: Come to think of it, that leader really did remind me of my younger self.

Content.SourceString: 我就知道店主你当年也是个狂妄的小鬼。
Content.LocalizedString: I knew it—back in the day, you were one cocky little troublemaker, shopkeep.

Content.SourceString: 哎哎，你这孩子嘴上还真不饶人！
Content.LocalizedString: Hey now, you really don't pull your punches, do you kid?

Content.SourceString: 怎么突然开始追忆往昔了？
Content.LocalizedString: Why the sudden trip down memory lane?

Content.SourceString: 人上了年纪，自然会这样的嘛。
Content.LocalizedString: That's just what happens when you get older.

Content.SourceString: 虽然操作技术还很粗糙，但我能感受到他对速度的追求！
Content.LocalizedString: His technique is still rough around the edges, but I can feel his pure passion for speed!

Content.SourceString: 他现在正是好年纪。没准再过两年，就能在赛场上看到他了。
Content.LocalizedString: He's at the perfect age right now. I bet we'll see him on the racing circuit in a couple of years.

Content.SourceString: 又开始关注赛车比赛了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Getting back into following the racing scene?

Content.SourceString: 哈哈，算是吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Haha, I suppose you could say that.

Content.SourceString: 和异象的比赛结束后，总感觉一些沉寂了十几年的东西重新苏醒了。
Content.LocalizedString: After racing against that Anomaly, I feel like something that's been dormant inside me for over a decade has finally awakened again.

Content.SourceString: 好多年没看赛事了，现在赛场上早都是些陌生面孔咯。但别说，他们身上的那股冲劲，还和我们那个时代的人如出一辙。
Content.LocalizedString: It's been years since I last watched any races. The track is filled with unfamiliar faces now. But you know what? That burning drive they have—it's exactly like the racers from our day.

Content.SourceString: 果然，追求速度的热血之心，大家都是一样的啊！
Content.LocalizedString: See? That burning passion for speed—it's the same in all of us racers, no matter when!

Content.SourceString: 或许「别让我停下！」也是因为这个原因才出现的呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Perhaps that's why "Don't Let Me Stop!" appeared too.

Content.SourceString: 嗯……没准呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm… you might be onto something.

Content.SourceString: 不过，经过了那场比赛，它应该也满足了吧！
Content.LocalizedString: But after that race, I bet it got its satisfaction!

Content.SourceString: 它的对手可是我这个新「海特洛车神」。
Content.LocalizedString: After all, it was up against me—the new God Racer of Hethereau.

Content.SourceString: 哈哈，确实。那天你真的跑得很漂亮！
Content.LocalizedString: Haha, you're right. You really drove beautifully that day!

Content.SourceString: 可惜我年轻的时候没能和你较量一场。
Content.LocalizedString: It's a shame I never got to race against you in my prime.

Content.SourceString: 自信
Content.LocalizedString: Confident

Content.SourceString: 说不定，它只是去别的城市寻找对手了。
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe it just went to another City to find new challengers.

Content.SourceString: 独自环游世界，不停地寻找能击败它的车手……
Content.LocalizedString: Wandering the world alone, endlessly searching for a driver who can defeat it…

Content.SourceString: 哈哈，听上去确实是我们赛车手做得出的事！
Content.LocalizedString: Haha, that sounds exactly like something we racers would do!

Content.SourceString: 有个好消息告诉你！今天有空吗，来趟店里吧！
Content.LocalizedString: I've got great news for you! Are you free today? Come by the shop!

Content.SourceString: 最好真的是
Content.LocalizedString: This better be good

Content.SourceString: 哎呀，来了你就知道了！
Content.LocalizedString: Ah, you'll see when you get here!

Content.SourceString: 我这阵子忙，先下了，你快过来哈！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm swamped right now, gotta go—but get over here ASAP, alright?
